data.narrative:
Onebrief, a Series D-stage defense and security technology company, raised $336M to reach a $2.15B post-money valuation. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Saronic, Quantum-Systems, Chaos Industries, True Anomaly, and Anduril Industries, all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $2.1B last post-money round, applies a typical 1.5x step-up multiplier for Series D-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $3.2B. Peer-median triangulation across the 4 same-sector, same-stage comparables in the dataset (Saronic at $9.2B, Quantum-Systems at $8.0B, Chaos Industries at $4.5B, True Anomaly at $2.2B) produces a median valuation of $6.2B, with a range spanning $2.2B to $9.2B.

The two methods imply a triangulated range of $2.7B (low) to $7.2B (high), with a median of $4.7B. The current $2.15B valuation sits below the stage-progression floor, reflecting either a discount relative to peer benchmarks or potential underpricing at the Series D entry. Key uncertainties include relative revenue multiples and growth rates versus peer set, capital efficiency trajectory, and sector-specific risks in defense and security markets.
